item.title: Thailand Sees US Chip Curbs as Risk to Data Center Drive
item.description: New US restrictions on the export and access to top-end semiconductors risks denting Thailand’s ambitions to be a hub for data centers, the foreign minister said. Foreign Minister Sihasak said in a BTV interview with Haslinda Amin that the new rules, announced this week just as President Donald Trump traveled to Asia, could impact its ambitions and that “we have to be more careful now.” (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Council on Foreign Relations’ McGuire on Trump-XI Meeting Implications for Chips
item.description: Chris McGuire, Council on Foreign Relations' Senior Fellow on China and Emerging Technologies discusses US restrictions on Nvidia chip sales and remote access, as the US president prepares to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping at the APEC summit. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Ed Ludlow on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: China Bank Rally Gains Momentum as Global AI Trade Unravels
item.description: Chinese bank stocks are gaining a tailwind as turmoil around Nvidia Corp. deepens cracks in the artificial intelligence trade and drives investors toward defensive bets.

item.title: Willy Shih on Risks With Nvidia’s Supply Chain
item.description: Willy Shih, Harvard Business School professor of management practice, discusses how NVIDIA’s supplier network and rising purchase commitments help it reserve production capacity amid intense competition. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Ed Ludlow on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Australia Revamps Pension Fund Test to Unlock New Investment
item.description: Australia’s government is overhauling the annual performance test for the nation’s pension funds, including introducing a new benchmark aimed at encouraging investment in a broader range of assets.
